build: Debug application, same compiler and Qt on both sides
method: Serial old/new/new/old runs of the same real-QEditor benchmark; 10 warmups +100 measured four-character replacements per location and document. Native compilation disabled. Event-turn duration includes syntax/UI work. The baseline app contains the new benchmark and unused delta helper, but uses the original adapter.
limits: Debug host work, not Release performance or edit-to-visible/compositor latency.
No engine workload, CPU sampling, builds or other test jobs during measured runs.
Numbers below are medians of the two per-run medians; raw samples retained.
